short: I perform reiki, a gentle Japanese energy healing modality to bring calm, balance, and connection to the whole body. It can be used to help with pain, regulating the nervous system, and cleanse one’s energy.
training: Trauma informed somatic bodywork therapy certification, Reiki Master Teacher Level and continuing education in Usui Ryoho Reiki certification, Sound healing Certification, Woman Healing and Feminine Embodiment certification.
long: I can offer face to face virtual sessions over zoom. As well as perform a distant reiki healing session without zoom if you are busy and unable to meet.
